featured.name: TruckersMP's Halloween Hunt

departure.location: Any City in The play area

arrive.location: Any City in The play area

featured.description:
Some of our ghosts went missing from the pumpkin farm so we think they are hiding in some of the trailers. 
   We need your help to find all seven different coloured ghosts around the area. 
   These ghosts only come out at night, so the pitch black sky will add an extra challenge to locating them! 
   Will you be the one to find them the quickest?
   But beware: the cheeky joker ghost loves to play tricks and jump around the play area. 
   Can you find him before he jumps to a new location?  

 You can find more information on our [Blog](https://truckersmp.com/blog/349)

   The event will begin on **1st of November 15:00 UTC** and you have until **1st of November 19:00 UTC** to find all the ghosts.
	 
 # You can park in any city within the play area
 ![](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/3a343db1-8a33-4f4e-8370-411b9c5a4e98.avif)
featured.rule:
**Event Rules for Ghost Hunters**
* All standard Arcade server rules apply unless stated below. Rules marked with an asterisk on the Official [TruckersMP rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) do not apply.
* Free roaming is prohibited outside the [playable area](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/3a343db1-8a33-4f4e-8370-411b9c5a4e98.avif).
* Participants must remain inside the map boundaries, as per §2.5 - Reckless Driving.
* Participants are permitted to drive any vehicle including a truck, bus, car, or AI vehicle.
* Participants should park in any company yard in a city listed on the "playable area" map before the start of the event. 
* Participants are prohibited from leaving the starting cities until an Event Manager has announced the event has begun.

featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - November 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official November Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Tirana, traveling through the Balkan to end in Rijeka.

The event takes place on the **8th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P3QHIrvSHSpH2)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38307.1791459212.jpg)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Tirana** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121262-official-ets2-convoy-november-2026/)**!
featured.rule:

today.name: EXPORT OF CZECH LITERATURE TO THE GERMANY!
today.description:
## EXPORT OF CZECH LITERATURE TO THE BOOK FAIR!
- Export České literatury na Frakfurtský knižní veletrh!
## 

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/Y7M4QMA.jpeg)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Follow company rules, they are of great importance.
4. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
5. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
6. Cargo is limited to the Office Papers.
7. Confirm your participation.
8. If your company has more than 5 members and you want to participate, you must reserve a slot on our Discord server - [link here.](https://discord.gg/lukytransport)
9. The convoy is mainly organized in Czech language, if you need please use translator, we will also use English.

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/PCv3Xb9/schedule.png)

*  **20:00**  - Meetup at parking slots in Brno.
*  **20:30** -  Departure from the Brno to the Germany border.
*  **20:40** -  Passage around the city of Prague.
*  **21:00** -  Passage around the city of Dresden.
*  **21:15** -  Passage around the city of Kassel.
*  **21:25** -  Convoy arrival to the Frankfurt.
*  **21:30** -  Final group photo and end of the event.

![](https://i.imgur.com/qPEhXyX.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/agKlA15.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/CKRRfZ8/CJ.png)

**1. Brno, LKW // Trameri - Frankfurt, Transinet.**

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/Kctz2JT/SLOT-RESERVATION.png)


To ride on this convoy for companies with more than 5 MEMBERS, slot registration is required.

For this, simply use the new slot feature on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/lukytransport).

**Correct Registration Procedure:**

1. [Select your slot](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225995618955300874) with the code number in the room or on the convoy page.
2. Create a new ticket for booking a slot in the [#ticket room on our Discord.](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225533050616676544)
3. Fill out the registration form, indicating the slot you are interested in.
4. Our management will confirm your registration through the ticket.

*Remember to monitor slot occupancy on the server and communicate with us.*


-----

## ALL SLOTS - SLOTS NO.1

![](https://i.imgur.com/euA9Mjs.jpeg)



*If your company has less than 5 members or you are a member of our company, you do not need to reserve a slot.*

upcoming.name: Oktober Konvoi Der Fire Phoenix
upcoming.description:
Wir starten um 20 Uhr unseren Oktober Monatskonvoi auf den Türkischen Straßen von Edirne aus in Richtung Jassy. (~1.330Km), guckt bitte das ihr rechtzeitig bereit steht und vorm Konvoi Start bitte die LKWs Repariert und Auftankt damit der Start reibungslos ablaufen kann und keine Probleme mit den LKWs unterwegs entstehen können.

Es wird bei diesem Konvoi eine 15 Minütige Pause eingeplant die in Pitesti auf den Speditionen Kaarfor u. Dom Depo Stattfinden wird. 

Folgender DLS ist erforderlich: https://store.steampowered.com/app/227310/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__Going_East/?curator_clanid=4419325

Wir Starten von Edirne mit Singletrailer (Maximal 10T Fracht) in Fahrtrichtung Landschaft. 

Zum Abschluss bleiben wir an der Spedition Kaarfor um Paar Gruppenbilder nach der Gemeinsamen fahrt zu machen, dafür Parken/stellen wir die Auflieger ein/zur Seite damit die nicht stören oder im Weg stehen
upcoming.rule:
Es gilten die Standart Konvoi regeln:
- Überholen ist Strickt untersagt. Wenn Fremdfahrer auf der Karte oder im Tab auftauchen sollten, Passieren lassen
- Konvoispitze gibt die Geschwindigkeit an, versucht bitte mindestens 100 Meter zu eurem Vorderman einzuhalten um rechzeitig reagieren zu können (ausweichen/Bremsen)

To celebrate TruckersFM turning 11 years old, we're throwing a one-of-a-kind party! Over the weekend, there will be loads to get involved with both in-game, and on-air.  
Want to come and join the celebrations? Dial in the radio to TruckersFM and come join us at our festival!

![TFM11 Festival Map](https://i.ibb.co/yFNvVcvG/tfm11-festival.jpg)

> **Server opens:** 17:00 BST  
**Festival starts:** 18:00 BST  
**Festival ends:** 23:00 BST  
**Location:** TruckersFM 11 City (located near London, UK)

---

At the festival, why not come and get involved with all of our events? There might even be prizes to be won!

## Bash the Bin
**Time:** TBC  
**Prize(s):** TBC  
Ever played TMP's "Knock the cone"? This is our twist on it! In front of you is a drag strip, with 3 bins lined up in a triangle at the end. The aim of the game is to bash the front bin (marked by the first of the two white lines) WITHOUT bashing the rear two bins (marked by the second of the two white lines). If you bash the rear bins (or cross the second line), you're out! The first to bash the first bin but not the second is the winner!  
![](https://i.ibb.co/RkhpLQj5/eut2-hq-6ac554ee.jpg)

## Off-road track
**Time:** TBC  
**Prize(s):** TBC  
Are you feeling adventurous? Why not take on the off-road track challenge! In this event, you'll be timed around our specially made off-road course, located in the TFM11 Quarry. There will be many challenges, on this course which will test the limits of your driving skills! You'll want to make a quicksave before taking part, as vehicle damage is guaranteed! How quickly can you get round the course?  
![](https://i.ibb.co/KpH3Tp6D/eut2-hq-6ac557ef.jpg)

## Race Track
**Time:** TBC  
**Prize(s):** TBC  
The ultimate test of speed! Bring out your fastest truck and race other players on our all new race track! Filled with exciting corners, straights, and lots of space for showing off your speed, the race track will crown the quickest drivers of the night! Be careful though, it's easy to flip a truck if you're cornering too fast!  
![](https://i.ibb.co/ZR4CpZV3/eut2-hq-6ac55888.jpg)

---

And there's so much more fun we haven't mentioned, such as the main stage where you can come and vibe with our staff & partners at TruckersMP! We can't wait to see you there, celebrating 11 Years of broadcasting!

## **[Why not also check out the #TFM11 Convoy?](https://truckersmp.com/events/35194)**

upcoming.name: From Moravia to the Baltic
upcoming.description:
## Pridružite nam se na uzbudljivoj ruti koja spaja srce Češke Republike sa istorijskim lučkim gradom na Baltičkom moru! Polazimo iz slikovitog Brna, drugog po veličini češkog grada, i vozimo se pravo na sever kroz živopisne pejzaže Poljske. Naš krajnji cilj je Gdanjsk, prelepa baltička luka poznata po svojoj bogatoj istoriji i arhitekturi.

## English:
## 
## Join us on an exciting route that connects the heart of the Czech Republic with a historic port city on the Baltic Sea! We depart from picturesque Brno, the second largest Czech city, and drive straight north through the picturesque landscapes of Poland. Our final destination is Gdansk, a beautiful Baltic port known for its rich history and architecture.
## 
##  Očekuje nas duga i dinamična vožnja koja zahteva maksimalnu koncentraciju, održavanje bezbednog rastojanja i poštovanje saobraćajnih propisa u okviru Convoy režima. Pripremite svoje kamione, napunite rezervoare i osigurajte teret za ovu fantastičnu evropsku rutu!

## English:
## 
## We are expecting a long and dynamic ride that requires maximum concentration, maintaining a safe distance and observing traffic regulations within the Convoy mode. Prepare your trucks, fill the tanks and secure the cargo for this fantastic European route!
